Subject: POC trial - recap, success criteria & next steps

Thanks for the call today — good discussion. Below is a short recap and proposed plan so we can align on success criteria, ownership, and timelines. Please reply with any edits or owners you want changed.

Summary of scope
- 2-week POC in dev environment to validate integration, latency, and cost for the screening workflow.
- Redwood will provide a dedicated test model instance and a small token budget for evaluation.

Proposed success criteria (must-have to consider POC successful)
- Integration: Feature-complete connector to HorizonCare API (patient anonymized) and end-to-end inference pipeline
- Latency: 95th percentile < 350ms for typical 512-token workload
- Accuracy/Quality: human-rated precision >= 85% on the agreed evaluation set (see attached eval prompts)
- Cost: per-1000-token cost projection under $X (we'll share model/quantization options)

Evaluation plan & timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW and sign minimal agreement
- Week 1: setup & integration (Redwood provides credentials, test model, and S3 prep)
- Week 2: run evaluation, collect metrics, human review sessions
- Week 3: review results, decide next steps (scale/Dedicated procurement or stop)

Ownership (initial proposal — please confirm)
- Infra (network, VPC, cloud access): HorizonCare infra team (David Lee)
- App integration (connector + mapping): HorizonCare dev lead (Sarah Nguyen)
- Security & compliance evidence: HorizonCare security (Michael Torres) + Redwood security for evidence bundles
- Procurement / legal: HorizonCare procurement (David Lee)
- Redwood PM & SE: Marissa Cole (PM) + Aditya Rao (Solutions Eng)

Next steps (actionable)
1) David / Sarah: confirm owners above by EOD Thursday 7/16
2) HorizonCare to complete and send the security questionnaire (see attached)
3) Redwood to send SOW + DocuSign link by tomorrow 7/15
4) Schedule kickoff: propose Mon 7/20 10am PT (hold tentative slot)

Attachments: POC SOW draft (attached), security questionnaire

Thanks — looking forward to running this.

--
